storyline.title: B6: how one number was measured, attacked, corrected and recorded
storyline.editorial_note: Captions are editorial summaries by the PM; the register rows and ledger entries they point to are the evidence.

steps.caption: First GFL measurement from 77 NEF raw stills: 2.27 ± 0.09 mm/s on a 13–53 s window chosen by hand.
Family run over eight 100 µm tests: two measured, six rejected by quality gates (rejections kept).
Red team #1 (ChatGPT) challenges the claim of agreement with the published value.
Clean-room re-run and robustness: the result moves with threshold choice (ISS-034).
Cause found: the flame brightens ×6.3 inside the window; brightness-invariant thresholds give 2.07–2.20.
Red team #2 and a radiometric audit: the edge also sharpens; the proposed single definition is withdrawn.
Blind analyst (Gemini): reported table not produced by its own code — rejected; second attempt measured a different edge.
AAL WF-0011: two blind AI analysts give 0.43 and 0.61 mm/s; GFL re-executes both scripts.
AI auditor (Mistral) confirms false statements; on return it fabricates line references.
Two AI red teams (grok-4.7, GPT-5.5): the window was chosen by hand, the flow changes inside it, ±0.094 is not a budget.
Deterministic re-execution on identical frames: the 3× gap is entirely frame selection.
Window rule fixed in Git before any per-segment rate; one segment qualifies: 1.99 mm/s at AIR 3.
Re-check (60 rule variants 1.88–2.07) and owner-approved correction; RES-001 superseded, analysis record AR-001.

history.text: **Evidence vault ("black box") boundary** (owner, 2026-11-05): the vault is **sealed after phase 2**. Phase 1 = primary instrument files + instrument record (model, era, resolution, calibration, clock); phase 2 = source tables exactly as published, any source-side computed value flagged `source_derived`, never corrected. Both immutable, content-addressed. Phase 3 (every analysis, including GFL's own measurements) and phase 4 (comparisons, updates, predictions) are **append-only records outside the seal**: each entry names method, code hash, parameters and parent hashes; corrections are new entries that explicitly supersede, with a version. Rationale: the seal protects the evidence, not the conclusions; an interpretation error must stay findable by walking the lineage back to phase 1–2

**GFL epistemic charter** (owner, 2026-11-05). GFL analyses data, not the prestige of whoever produced it; citing a source is the respect we owe it, verification is the rule for everyone. Zero trust applies equally to NASA, to published authors, to GFL's own analyses, to Claude, to ChatGPT and to the Project Owner ("I can be the largest source of alteration"). No analysis is tuned toward an expected result; every uncertainty is shown; every approximation is named **and carried downstream** — an approximate value never becomes certain in a later analysis. Ranking in the competition is subordinate to this ("better disqualified than a prize built on error or manipulation"). Implementation: ledger `qualification` entries + `gfl lineage` (inherited qualifiers with the entry that introduced each); key holder cannot silently rebuild the chain because the head is anchored externally (Git + RFC 3161) after every working session

**Separation of signing authority — zero trust includes the AI agent** (owner, 2026-11-05: "trust zero is not cosmetic or marketing; it is one of GFL's pillars"). Two key roles: `pipeline` (held by the processing environment, i.e. the AI agent) signs ingests, derivations, qualifications and anchors; `owner` (generated and held only by the Project Owner, passphrase-encrypted, never in the processing environment) signs `approval` entries only. `gfl verify` fails if an approval carries a pipeline signature or an owner key signs data. The owner signs on his own computer with `tools/gfl_owner.py` (one self-contained, auditable file), which recomputes every hash itself and shows the exact decision text before asking for YES; the pipeline can only *request* an approval and *attach* the signed result. Consequence: the agent cannot claim an approval that was not given, the owner cannot later deny one he signed, and neither can rewrite history without breaking the external anchors. Documentation: section "Zero-trust model — including the AI agent" in the WP5 architecture document (no new documents before 9 Nov, per schedule) | Accepted; implemented (`src/gfl_ledger`, 5 role tests); owner key generation pending on the owner's machine

**Pre-registration of the front definition for measurement v0.2** (proposed by PM; owner approval required, to be signed): leading edge = last column above a fraction of **that frame's own peak** of the band-averaged radiance, fractions {0.05, 0.1, 0.2} predeclared, fit window predeclared per run from the video overlay flow steps (one rate per constant-flow interval) instead of the travel-percentile rule. Chosen on physical grounds (invariance to radiance growth), fixed **before** any other run is processed. Explicit note: it moves B6 toward Carmignani's ≈2 mm/s; that is not a reason for the choice and must not be presented as agreement
**Withdrawn by PM** in its proposed form (RES-008): no single threshold definition is invariant to both brightening and edge sharpening in B6

**B6 reported as a set of kinematic indicators** (proposed by PM, owner approval required; adopts IDEA-032-D and -F): luminous leading edge at absolute thresholds, luminous leading edge at per-frame fractions 0.05–0.5, peak-radiance position, each with its own rate, fit statistics and qualifiers. No "the front speed" is selected; the term is "luminous leading edge", not reaction front. The indicator list and fractions are frozen in this entry **before** any other run is processed; literature comparison only after the freeze. Piecewise-flow fits (IDEA-032-C) wait for the overlay flow timeline (ISS-013)

**B6 fit-window rule R-W1** (`docs/B6_WINDOW_RULE_v1.md`), written and committed (a986d4a) with its selection stage **before any per-segment rate was computed**. Per-frame gates from properties that do not use the front's time trend: G1 flame present (peak > 20 × robust noise), G2 front ≥ 50 columns from both image edges, G3 no flame clipping (raw saturated pixels ≤ 10 × the run median), G4 continuity (gap ≤ 5 s, cumulative), G5 ±3 s guard around AIR-display changes. One rate per constant-flow segment (≥ 6 frames over ≥ 6 s); HAC and moving-block bootstrap; component budget. Not a true pre-registration: RES-001 and RES-019 were known. **R-W2** (41d1578), declared after the R-W1 selection and before any rate: a segment is the interval between AIR changes and a failed frame no longer splits it (R-W1 split AIR = 3 on the clipped frame at 26.57 s). Both reported

**Analysis record: `docs/analysis/AR-001_B6_spread_rate_window_correction.md` (ledger seq 103).** **B6 headline result corrected (owner approval 2026-11-10, after RES-022):** "B6, BASS-II 100 µm PMMA, AIR display 3 interval (18.5–28.6 s): leading-edge spread rate ≈ 2.0 mm/s — 1.99 mm/s (reference: 0.1 of frame peak), statistical 95 % 1.84–2.13, front-definition range 1.99–2.20 (relative) / up to 2.54 (absolute), rule variants 1.88–2.07, scale ±3 %, ruler–sample parallax and luminous-edge–pyrolysis offset [UNKNOWN]; AIR display to cm/s mapping open (ISS-013)." RES-001 (2.274 ± 0.094 mm/s, 13–53 s chosen by hand, iid fit SE) is kept as history and superseded as headline (ledger supersession). Consequences: (a) RES-002 family values (B6 2.32 ± 0.10, B15 2.39 ± 0.10) were measured with the pre-R-W windows and iid SE; they are qualified as superseded method, to be re-measured under R-W when each run's overlay is transcribed; (b) RES-002's observation "B6 ≈ B15 despite higher B15 flow" is **withdrawn** — it compared flow-mixed B6 with B15; (c) release acceptance (RELEASE_A: "B6 reproduced against published ≈2 mm/s within declared uncertainty") is assessed only after the comparator's own conditions are matched — agreement is not a reason for the choice (DEC-032 note stands)

(2) The 6.3× ≈ 6.67 exposure-ratio coincidence is the expected signature of auto-exposure: the raw-DN peak stays constant (last5/first5 = 1.00) while the shutter shortens, so normalised radiance ∝ 1/exposure — real brightening, but resting entirely on EXIF exposure accuracy (now an explicit qualifier). (3) Not only the peak grows: integrated band radiance ×9.1 (corr 0.93), flame area ×2.1 (corr 0.98), R/G 2.7 → 3.6 — the flame grows and changes emission, i.e. **shape change is real**.
